business_framing: Prioritize candidate proxies that look closer to highway service-area use cases, then let the MILP spread selected sites for unique NUTS3 demand coverage.

filters.pool_rule: top candidates by highway-corridor priority score

business_framing: Bias the candidate pool toward lower-population zones and zones with weaker observed charger density, then optimize for unique covered demand inside that pool.

filters.pool_rule: top candidates by rural underserved priority score
filters.rural_proxy: inverse NUTS3 population within the four-country pilot
filters.underserved_proxy: inverse observed OSM charger density per 100k residents

business_framing: Bias toward high-demand zones where the public charger-density proxy is weakest, then test whether MILP can cover more demand than a simple ranked shortlist.

filters.pool_rule: top candidates by high-demand charger-gap priority score
filters.competitor_gap_proxy: high population times inverse observed OSM charger density
